_derivation_note: Hand-derived from an independent re-implementation (not copy-pasted) of the page's stated Keplerian-influence-radius / kinematic-S/N model: r_infl = G*M/(2*sigma0^2) (influence radius), sigma_Kep = sqrt(G*M/(2*r_eval)) evaluated at r_eval=r_infl/2 (note this reduces algebraically to sigma_Kep = sigma0*sqrt(2), independent of M -- an intrinsic self-similarity of the evaluation-point choice, confirmed by direct substitution and by the constant 28.28 km/s appearing in both cases despite different M/dist/crowding). N_eval floors at max(3, round(...)); case 1's min_detectable_mass_dr4 legitimately saturates the binReturn search floor (lo=100 M_sun) because kinSN(100 M_sun, ...) already exceeds the 3-sigma threshold at these (dist,crowding,sigma0) -- documented as a floor-limited result, not a defect. Case 2 is well clear of the floor (206,890 M_sun).
